notes.title: Update the translation of the English subtitles.
notes.content:
1. Modified some known bugs.
2. The English subtitles have been upgraded from previous machine translation to more professional translation.

notes.title: Fix known bugs.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the black screen issue caused by clicking on ending nodes.
2. Added auto-save functionality for settings when the language is set to English.
3. Fixed the bug that continuously checked configurations at startup.

notes.title: Updated on April 28th
notes.content:
Fixed some known bugs.

Based on player feedback regarding issues such as getting electrocuted in Chapter 3 and getting stuck in the fish pond in Chapter 4, more specific hints have been added to the ending page. Players can follow these hints to try and complete the level.

For the lag issues reported by some players, some have already been resolved, while others are still being adjusted. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to provide feedback in the official group.
